sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior owner and thruster-body-scoped applicability corrections, but reject this as a presence-only check: it verifies damping, waterAddedMass, thrusterNaturalFrequency, and shipAttachmentStiffness independently of each linked calculation case and does not encode that those inputs are taken into account in the longitudinal and transverse natural-frequency estimation. Add a canonical calculation/model input relationship or registered evidence path linking each relevant case to all four inputs, including damping; the required linkage term is absent from the scoped vocabulary, so locate it rather than inventing one. Keep both direction requirements and the authoritative owners unchanged.
